$schema_note: Centralized LLM judge config for sciMAS grading. Override with env vars using one of the prefixes below.
$credentials_note: A key is read from an env-var prefix first, and only then from this file's own top-level api_key/api_base/model. Put real credentials in config/llm_judge.local.json (git-ignored), never in this tracked file — anything written here gets committed. This block is documentation only and is never read as a credential.

env_var_layout._API_KEY: API key (required to enable any LLM judge path). The historical RESEARCH_CLAW_JUDGE_API_KEY / JUDGE_API_KEY suffix is preferred; the bare _KEY suffix is also recognized for consistency.
env_var_layout._API_BASE: OpenAI-compatible chat-completions base URL. Falls back to default_api_base when unset.
env_var_layout._MODEL: Model name (e.g. gpt-4.1, claude-3-7-sonnet-...). Required when _API_KEY is set.

$default_max_tokens: The judge only ever replies 正确/错误; 5 tokens was sized for a plain chat model. A reasoning model (deepseek-flash) bills its hidden thinking against the same budget, so at 5 it returns an empty content with finish_reason=length and the verdict never arrives. 2048 leaves room to think and then answer; it is a cap, not a reservation.

SciAgentGYM.notes: Uses the official SciAgentGYM is_answer_correct prompt: ask the LLM whether the model's answer is equivalent to the standard answer. Two extra blocks may be inlined, and they are not equivalent. metadata.golden_answer (a usable step chain) is context only - the chain is NOT the target: in most entries where it disagrees with `answer`, its last valued step is a helper (a tension, a radius of gyration). metadata.solution_steps (the dataset's own account of the solution) DOES steer the verdict: on some entries `answer` holds an intermediate value - for the Horwitz-trumpet entry `answer` is 2.8% (the between-laboratory RSD) while the question asks for the within-laboratory RSD the steps name, 1.41421 - so when it is present a fifth rule tells the judge to follow the quantity the question actually asks for. metadata.image_path figures are attached to the same message as OpenAI vision content blocks, with a numbered rule saying they belong to the QUESTION, not to the model's answer - the opposite of ResearchClawBench, where the attached image is the ground-truth target. A judge model that cannot accept image content fails the vision call, is retried text-only, and the reason is recorded in the grade notes (llm_judge.get_last_image_note). The image caps (4 MB per image, 12 MB total, 12 images) are code constants in tests/llm_judge.py, not config keys. Falls back to the deterministic text/numeric grader when the API is not configured.

ResearchClawBench.notes: Uses the upstream multimodal checklist judge (rcb_official_judge.score_checklist) with the same credentials.
